text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — doing a preflight for release bundle 2023.11 at 09:30 PT. This is a lite smoke only (no load testing). Need owners for runtime, routing, infra to ack and confirm rollbacks.

Alex: I'm runtime owner, allocated 09:30 slot. I'll be on-call and watching logs. What are the exact smoke gates?

Devon: Routing owner here. Can run canary routing check and sanity `/health`. Send the curl I should run.

Maya: TL;DR smoke checklist: 1) CI deploy job green, 2) /health returns 200, 3) sample generation returns short token (sanity prompt), 4) no CrashLoopBackOff or >1 error pod for 5m after rollout. Quick commands: 
```
# smoke generate (replace $TOKEN)
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -d '{ "model":"redwood-v1", "prompt":"ping" }' | jq -r .choices[0].text

# health check
curl -sS https://routing.redwood.example/health | jq -r .status
```

Sam: CI link: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/202311-rc3 — will post live logs during deploy. I'll annotate any infra errors.

Lina: On rollback standby. Rollback playbook (short):
`kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/mod-runtime`
Then pin image back: `kubectl set image deployment/mod-runtime mod-runtime=redwood/mod-runtime:2023.10.4 -n prod`
If latency/regression shows up in traces, initiate rollback and ping #eng-oncall.

Alex: Noted. I'll watch the runtime pods' `kubectl describe` and `logs -f`. If the sample gen returns anything non-JSON or error codes, I'll start rollback. Threshold: >2 failed sample gen attempts in 5m.

Devon: I'll run the routing check and confirm traffic split 95/5 to canary. Command I use: `kubectl -n prod get svc routing -o yaml` + `curl` above.

deploy-bot: Info: scheduled deploy window 2023-11-08T09:30:00Z for bundle 2023.11 by pipeline `release/2023.11`. CI job queued.

Maya: If everyone acks we start at :30 sharp. Please post one-line ack when you're set. Also reminder: no schema migrations in this window — it's a runtime/deps-only rollout.

Sam: ACK — logs link open, will post failures inline. :thumbsup:

Lina: ACK — rollback ready, will be standing by.

Alex: ACK — on-call, will ping here before initiating rollback.

Devon: ACK — canary checks ready.

Maya: Great — starting preflight checklist 5m before deploy and will post final go/no-go. Thanks all. :rocket:
